views: view1: ขยายบันได 1 1/25 ชั้นล่าง - ชั้น 2 (ช่วงล่าง + ชานพัก 1 + ช่วงบน) (this file)
view2: ขยายลูกขั้นบันได (this file, folded into the stair entry)
warnings: Dog-leg stair 1 in the stair halls (bays 3-4 / 9-10). The section is cut along the y axis: left = row D side (1.60 | 2.50 | 1.20 = D''-D, D-C, C-B'''' at floor 2), lower support G3 on row C, middle G4 on row B, G7 on row A (4.00 | 4.00 at the bottom) - matched to the S-02/S-03 beam positions, the sheet itself prints no grid bubbles.

Lower flight: floor 1 (ชั้นที่ 1, at G3) up 2.45 to ชานพัก 1 (landing slab S3 on B6/B3); upper flight: ชานพัก 1 up 1.05 to floor 2, run 2.80 (= B to B'''' 6.80, the B5 landing-beam line of S-03). 2.45 + 1.05 = 3.50 floor to floor. Step detail (ขยายลูกขั้นบันได): riser 0.175, tread 0.275 + nosing 0.025 (flights print 0.30 / 0.025). Riser count not printed - 2.45/0.175 = 14 and 1.05/0.175 = 6 by arithmetic, kept out of the data.

Bar callouts are listed per flight as printed. 'DB12mm.@0.10m.' is boxed on the lower flight (probably flagged as the governing main bar); 'DB12mm.@0.20m.' is also printed on that flight. Which bar is top/bottom of the waist is not labelled - recorded with neutral locations.

Grid sweep: the y rows 1.60 | 2.50 | 1.20, 2.80 and 4.00 | 4.00 bind to existing lines (D'', D, C, B'''', B, A). The '0.65 | 0.65' pair either side of G4 (row B) bounds the 'ลดระดับประมาณ 5 ซม.' strip of slab S2 - two new y ticks (B -0.65 / B +0.65) staged for the grid master. Vertical 2.45 / 1.05 / 2.05 are z rows (staged when the datum is known).
Sheet box: 'เหล็กเสริมข้ออ้อย ทั้งหมด ให้ใช้ชั้นคุณภาพ SD 40' (4th S-sheet with that wording).
